tools.name: read_page_as_markdown
tools.description: Return the current page as clean markdown instead of HTML, so it can be quoted or summarized without parsing the layout. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: search_fume_docs
tools.description: Search Fume's documentation — AI agents for fund operations, the tokenization whitepaper and user guides, OmniClear settlement, and the developer API reference. Returns ranked fragments with the page URL.

query.description: Words to search the documentation for.

tools.name: search_fund_service_providers
tools.description: Search Fume's directory of fund service providers — legal, fund administration, custody, exchange/broker, audit, AIFM and insurance. Returns JSON with the category list alongside the matches.

q.description: Free-text search over name, description, specialty, tags and jurisdictions.

category.description: Category id to filter by: legal, fund-admin, custody, broker, auditor, aifm or insurance.

limit.description: Maximum providers to return (1-200). Defaults to 100.

tools.name: search_tokenized_funds
tools.description: Search Fume's Tokenized Fund Registry — tokenized investment funds with their manager, strategy, asset class, AUM, chain, token standard, fees and jurisdiction. Returns JSON; every fund carries a `url` to its page on this site.

q.description: Free-text search over name, manager, issuer, strategy and description.

chain.description: Blockchain to filter by, e.g. Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base.

assetClass.description: Asset class to filter by, e.g. Fixed Income, Private Credit.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction to filter by, e.g. Luxembourg, Cayman Islands.

status.description: Fund status: live, upcoming or closed.

limit.description: Maximum funds to return (1-200). Defaults to 50.
